_purpose: Per-dealer scheduling rules for the Ava voice agent. Edit and redeploy; no code change needed. Null means unknown. Items marked NEEDS_APPROVAL were set to safe defaults and should be confirmed by the dealership.

hours._source: balisenissanri.com hours page, read 2026-09-16. NissanUSA's listing shows 8 to 5 and 8 to 2; confirm with the store.

amenities: Express Service for oil changes and quick maintenance

booking._slotOpcodeField: auto | opcode | opcodes. The spec schema says opcode, the sample says opcodes; auto probes once at startup using the free Slots API.
booking._serviceAdvisorIdField: auto | employeeDisplayNumber | employeeId | id. auto probes at startup.
booking._cancelNotifyFlagValue: Sent as donotNotifyCustomer. Field name and description conflict in the spec; false is safe under either reading. NEEDS_APPROVAL.
booking._updateTimestampFormat: epoch | iso. Schema says int64 epoch ms; the sample shows an ISO string.
booking._rescheduleJobsMode: updatedJobs (existing jobs sent with ids in updatedJobs, jobs=[]) | jobs (existing jobs re-sent in jobs without ids). Verify jobs are preserved in a test reschedule.
booking._mileageInComments: Vehicle Update has no mileage field. The reported mileage is written into customerComments so the advisor sees it at check-in.

pricing._quotePolicy: none: the agent never quotes prices. postTaxTotalAmount is computed from the opcode catalog's flat prices where present, otherwise 0.

transportation._note: Names are matched case-insensitively against the dealer's Tekion transportation catalog. First match wins. The agent only offers types listed here. NEEDS_APPROVAL for loaner/shuttle eligibility.

options._requiresAdvisor: Loaner availability is not guaranteed by the Transportation API; the advisor confirms.

services._note: Approved phone-bookable menu. opcode null means: resolve at startup by searching the dealer's Tekion opcode catalog with descriptionContains (first active match). Anything the caller asks for that does not match a menu item is booked as a custom concern (Tekion's customConcern opcode) with the caller's words as the job concern, unless allowCustomConcern is false. policies.arrivalInstructions: Please arrive about ten minutes early and pull into the service drive at 1350 Post Road; an advisor will meet you.
policies.cancellationPolicy: Appointments can be cancelled or moved any time before the visit; there is no fee.

symptomGuide._note: Spoken guidance for common complaints. The agent must never diagnose or quote a repair; it names common possibilities in plain language, states the safety note, and offers to book. Edit freely.

entries.spoken: A vehicle that pulls to one side at speed is most often tire pressure or wear, or the wheel alignment. It can also be a brake issue. It is worth having looked at soon rather than driving on it for long. I can book an alignment and tire check.

A shake or vibration usually points to tire balance or wear, or sometimes brake rotors if it happens when braking. The technicians can pin it down with a road test and inspection. I can book a tire and brake check.
Squealing or grinding when braking is usually the brake pads reaching their wear indicator, or a worn rotor. Grinding especially should be looked at promptly. I can book a brake inspection.

A steady check engine light means the car has stored a code that needs to be read; it is safe to drive to the dealership. If the light is flashing, or the car is running rough, please avoid driving it and we can help arrange a tow. I can book a diagnostic visit.

A slow or clicking start is most commonly the battery or a connection, though the starter can also be the cause. If it is starting now, I can book a battery and charging test. If it will not start at all, I can connect you to the service team about a tow.

Overheating should not be driven on; it can damage the engine. If the temperature gauge is high, please pull over safely and let me connect you to the service team. If it was a one-time reading, I can book a cooling system check.

A burning smell or smoke is something the technicians should see soon, and if there is visible smoke please do not keep driving it. I can connect you to the service team now, or book the earliest inspection.

Noises are hard to place over the phone; the technicians will road test the vehicle to reproduce it. If you can note when it happens, such as turning, braking, or over bumps, that helps the advisor. I can book an inspection.

A tire pressure light usually means one tire is low; temperature swings can trigger it too. Checking the pressures is the first step, and if a tire keeps losing air it may have a puncture. I can book a tire check.
Air that is not cold is often low refrigerant or a component in the system, and the technicians can test it. I can book an air conditioning check.

Nissan's maintenance schedule varies by model and mileage; the service advisor can pull the exact schedule for your vehicle. Most vehicles are due for an oil change and inspection every five to seven thousand miles or six months. I can book a maintenance visit.
